svg.title: Patrick Luo — 3D GitHub contribution calendar
svg.desc: Sep 24, 2025 — Sep 23, 2026. 328 contributions across 57 active days, from 365 daily GitHub counts updated on 2026-09-23. Each day is a tile. Tower height is linear at 4 pixels per contribution above a 2.5 pixel tile. Active columns rise once, then remain still.
